likely_causes.cause: Blower not moving enough air while compressor runs

homeowner_checks: Turn the system to Off or Fan-only and let ice melt completely before restarting Cool
Do not chip ice off the coil
call_pro_when: Ice returns after a full thaw with a clean filter and open vents.
sources: Generic residential freeze-up practice; airflow first
assumptions: No pressure transducers in v1 — freeze-up is inferred, not measured by gauges
